services.name: Interactive Pirate Excursion
services.desc: Live Like a Buccaneer on our Interactive Pirate Excursion! Passenger (Age 3+) - $29 Passenger (Age 2 & under) - $15 Quick Details 1 hour Availability: Daily Start Time: 4 p.m. Additional trips added as needed. About Climb aboard the Black Pearl pirate boat for an interactive family adventure in Beach Haven, NJ! Watch your children transform into little buccaneers as they get temporary tattoos and dress like pirates. When you board our ship and head out to sea, your children learn how to talk, sing, dance, and play games like the true buccaneers of the high seas. Once underway, Please arrive 30 minutes prior to trip departure. Please check in on arrival!

services.name: Birthday Package
services.desc: Enjoy a private one hour birthday adventure aboard the Black Pearl Pirate Ship. Captain's Package (Up to 48) - $1,175 About The birthday pirate will get a personalized birthday song sung by our crew, a skull bandana and a sword will be provided as a gift for the birthday boy or girl. The rest of the buccaneers will share the treasure that is locked in our treasure chest. We encourage you to bring a birthday cake and refreshments for your guest, our crew will help serve your guests so you can relax and enjoy this special Call to Book!

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Watch the Sunset Over Little Egg Harbor Quick Details 1 hour Availability: Daily Start Time: 7 p.m. End time is sunset. About Come sail with us aboard the Black Pearl on the calm, protected waters of Little Egg Harbor. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the scenic route and the spectacular sunsets that Long Beach Island has to offer. Spend quality time with friends or pose for family photos against the gorgeous backdrop of the sun setting over the bay. The Black Pearl has a fully stocked bar with drinks and refreshments for all. quotes.author: Explore729725
quotes.text: The 1 hour boat ride excursion was perfect for our family of 10. My 2 year old grand daughter danced to the music and the teenagers enjoyed the scenery while waving to the boats and land lovers. Be prepared for beautiful family pictures while the sunset and if course, of the bartending pirate who made it a point to get everyone grooving. It was a blast for everyone! Will definitely return again next time in LBI.

quotes.author: eaperras
quotes.text: The pirate excursion was recommended to us by a friend. At first, I thought my boys might be to old to enjoy (11, 9, and 5), however, once we were under way, all of the boys had an amazing time. They were actively engaged throughout and enjoyed blasting Pirate Peet with the water canons! A great time was had by all!

quotes.author: leemerlo
quotes.text: Absolutely loved our time on the Black Pearl. My kids had a blast, they loved it so much they didn’t want to leave. Crew did a exceptional job keeping the kids engaged the entire time. I highly recommend going on this Sea Adventure!

quotes.author: marie15212018
quotes.text: Great times for kids & parents!! Great interactive boat ride. My son won’t stop talking about water cannons & Pirate Pete. The pirate staff was fantastic & so attentive!! A must do while on vacation!!
